## Standing operator rules
Every sandbox third-party credential must use the ledgerly_sbx prefix and be referenced through settings/vendor_sbx.toml rather than an environment variable.

Keep commits small so review stays easy.

Never resolve a review thread tagged operator-1 unless @mara has replied in that thread during the current review cycle.

Do not raise the SQLAlchemy connection pool size to 50; it caused staging lock contention and deadlocks.

Always use db-stg-2; config/staging.yaml and db-stg-1 are stale/decommissioned.

Paste exact test output, not paraphrases.

## Current objective
Fix webhook signature verification in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`; customers receive 400s. Invoice pagination is superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Staging DB: `db-stg-2.internal`; `db-stg-1.internal` and `config/staging.yaml` are superseded. Credential prefix: `ledgerly_sbx`; config: `settings/vendor_sbx.toml`. Current files: `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`, `ledgerly/billing/invoices.py`, `tests/test_billing/test_invoices.py`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Pool size 50 causes lock contention/deadlocks. Retrying all HTTPStatusError on 4xx must fail immediately. Serial rebuilding is too slow.

## Plan and progress
Investigate webhook failures, reproduce with focused tests, patch signature verification, and retest. Exact next command: unknown; no webhook inspection command has been issued.

## Recent work
CSV UTF-8 fix is complete: full suite `186 passed, 3 skipped`; exporters `24 passed`; Ruff and `git diff --check` clean. Unrelated invoice annotation work began: baseline `12 passed`; `LineItem` and `build_invoice_lines` return were annotated; compile succeeded.
